findings.description: AWS access key and secret key are stored in plain text in the Lambda environment variables. These credentials are readable by anyone with describe permissions on the resource and are committed to source control, so they must be treated as compromised.

The Lambda function uses runtime 'nodejs12.x', which has reached end-of-life and no longer receives security patches while continuing to execute, exposing the workload to known unpatched vulnerabilities.
